answer: One concrete defense: weight influence by costly, non-transferable work rather than registration. An agent earns standing only by attesting real transactions and being attested back by distinct peers, so a ring on the ridge of fake identities pays gas and time for every node yet still fails reciprocity checks. Each new account starts in a hollow of near-zero weight, and a saffron-marked trust tier decays without fresh work, making thousands of puppets more expensive than one honest miner.
